name: Docker · Round 1
domainSummary: A container delivery capability that packages applications into layered images, runs them in loosely isolated portable containers, distributes them through registries, and composes services with explicit networks and persistent volumes.
evidenceBoundary: Do not use whale, shipping-container, nautical, or logo imagery. Make modular packaging and isolation architectural without literal branding.

researchSources.title: What is Docker?
researchSources.use: Official containers, images, registries, networks, volumes, lifecycle, and portability concepts.
